description: Figure 2, titled "Ever-scalingness," is a circular diagram divided into four colored quadrants, each representing a key desideratum for a successful benchmark for LLMs. The top-left yellow quadrant, labeled "Uncrushable," is associated with "Complexity" and features an icon of a ladder. The top-right light blue quadrant, labeled "Unhackable," corresponds to "Instance" and includes a shield icon. The bottom-left red quadrant, labeled "Auto-verifiable," is linked to "Scalable Oversight" and displays an icon of a document with a checkmark. The bottom-right green quadrant, labeled "General," relates to "Coverage" and is marked with a globe icon. Each quadrant is connected by a colored line to its corresponding label outside the circle, visually organizing the four core principles.
